seo_need.buyer_research: Local, search-led and comparison-heavy: homeowners search 'painters near me' / 'best painters <city>' / cost questions, read Yelp/Thumbtack/Angi/Houzz/BuildZoom listicles and Reddit threads, and request several quotes; referrals matter too. Every category query returned listicles plus local painters' cost guides: a contested space. AI assistants are reported to be a growing step (vendor stats, unverified: 28% of US homeowners planning a remodel use ChatGPT/Perplexity/AI Overviews to pick a contractor; 48.5% of homeowners who use ChatGPT found a provider through it). Craftwork itself added llms.txt, .md mirrors and an OpenAI domain verification, so it believes AI answers matter. Still, local choice is dominated by the map pack and reviews, where Craftwork already wins in Charlotte. add-vee's journey analysis applies partly (the questions a couple asks across the quote journey: cost, cabinet paint vs replace, Hardie board, trust in the crew); its committee analysis does not (1-2 deciders).
